name: maximkleyer.github.io
description: Personal site. Static pages at the root plus three Vite apps built into root-level folders and committed, served by branch-based GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: npm run build:gm-sim && npm run build:champions && npm run build:pocket
scripts.build:gm-sim: npm --prefix gm-sim-react install && npm --prefix gm-sim-react run build
scripts.build:champions: npm --prefix champions-speed-calc install && npm --prefix champions-speed-calc run build
scripts.build:pocket: npm --prefix pocket-summoner install && npm --prefix pocket-summoner run build
